description: Low-profile mechanical switch MX stem
notes: Binary. Plate cutout must be measured. Soldered. Thumb keys may want a lighter spring - decide at M1

description: Keycap 16.5x16.5mm blank black MX stem
notes: Sold in 5-packs - 18 keys needs 4 packs. Smaller than 18mm MX spacing. 74HC preferred over LVC for ~2x input noise margin, not for speed - over an unterminated loom LVC's faster edges are worse

description: Real-time MCU: ESP32-S3 + onboard QMI8658C 6-axis IMU
notes: Mounted low for acceleration sensitivity. 16 GPIO broken out (1-7, 34-40, 43, 44) vs 14 needed. Native USB - verified, not a UART bridge - so USB MIDI works. 4MB flash, 2MB QUAD PSRAM: confirm quad at E1, octal would eat GPIO33-37. The 8x8 matrix faces out through a tail window as a second display (ADR 0014) - measure idle draw at E1 to size the shared lighting budget

description: Pressure transducer 0-6kPa gauge conditioned
notes: ~1ms response = ~159Hz corner. Loop runs 4kHz; rate lives on the DAC side. EOL since 2021 - distributor stock only, and the gel die coat swells on water vapour. BUY SPARES NOW: this is the real mitigation, not the trap

description: 12-bit 2-ch SAR ADC SPI
notes: SOIC-8. VDD-referenced so no separate ref chip. 50ksps at 3V3 vs 4-8kHz needed. One spare channel

description: 6-axis IMU - accel + gyro no fusion
notes: Fusion not wanted - raw accel is the signal and capture-on-press makes drift irrelevant. 6-axis confirmed from CircuitPython/Zephyr board definitions, not the listing. SDA=GPIO11 SCL=GPIO12 INT1=GPIO10 INT2=GPIO13. This IS the final IMU - the carrier is passive

description: 8-bit parallel-in shift register
notes: SOIC-16. The 'better drive over a 14in chain' rationale was backwards - faster edges into an unterminated loom ring. Kept for its native 3V3 spec, WITH 33-68R series termination. 74HC165 is a drop-in on the same footprint if E4 says otherwise

description: 1.91in 536x240 AMOLED RM67162 QSPI + ESP32-S3
notes: 60x25.5x10mm - mounts lengthwise. 18 GPIO broken out

description: 12V to 5V switching regulator module
notes: 3-pin SIP on a 7805 footprint. No inductor no feedback network no layout risk. 1A vs ~350mA needed

description: Addressable LED strip - two runs in the side channels
notes: 12V native so no 5V rail. Backup data line survives a dead LED. TWO independent strips - no crossover wire. Density pending diffusion test

part: DAC8568C (or A grade) - full orderable P/N required
description: Octal 16-bit DAC SPI, internal reference
notes: Populate 7 of 8: pitch, 4 mods, breath ambient-zero, mod offset. A/C grade resets to ZERO scale - B/D reset to midscale and park pitch octaves up. Internal ref is DISABLED by default, enable at boot. AVDD from U-REG-DAC

description: Dual low-drift RRIO op-amp
notes: ONE op-amp part throughout the module - pitch, mod 1-4, breath scaling. RRIO on +/-12V reaches ~11.9V

description: Superseded by U-OPA-PITCH
notes: Single part number beats saving a few dollars on a one-off. Removes a class of assembly error

description: Matched resistor network for pitch scaling
notes: Highest-value precision part in the design. Ratio tracking is what matters not absolute tempco

description: 3.5mm mono PCB-mount jack
notes: De facto eurorack standard. Standard panel hole

part: Alpha 9mm vertical PCB mount, B50k linear
description: Panel potentiometer - breath gain and offset
notes: Linear taper - predictable for CV scaling. Gain then offset order

description: Panel power switch - drives the load switch enable, carries no load current
notes: Signal-level only now. The only power switch in the system; SW-PWR-INST is deleted (ADR 0005)

description: Current-limited load switch on the umbilical +12V feed
notes: Adjustable limit set ~500mA. Inrush ramp into the instrument bulk caps; foldback on an umbilical fault so the rack rail is not pulled down

description: 8-conductor ruggedised connector, both ends
notes: Any Cat5 cable works. Panel cutout is laser cut anyway so complexity is free. VERIFY 24mm flange in 30mm panel

description: Eurorack front panel
notes: Laser or waterjet from DXF - SAME vendor and order as the key plate

description: Aluminium key plate laser or waterjet cut
notes: Flat 2D through-cuts only - no CNC needed

description: Oak top and bottom panels
notes: Bottom panel thickness sets thumb key inset depth

description: Frosted acrylic side panels
notes: Edge-lit

description: Scopes, logic analysers, DMMs, signal generators, RF
notes: Full bench available - E9 not gated on tooling

description: 5.000V precision series reference for the breath sensor supply
notes: +-0.05%, 3ppm/degC, ~5ppm/V line reg. The MPXV4006GP is ratiometric so its supply IS its scale factor. Buffered by half of U-BUF

description: Dual RRIO op-amp: breath buffer + reference buffer
notes: SOIC-8. Runs on +12V not 5V - a +12V fault on the BREATH conductor is at the rail so no clamp current, which kills the >=3.3k protection resistor requirement. SAME part as the module op-amps

description: Instrumentation amp - breath receiver, senses against AGND
notes: Buffered GOhm inputs make source impedance irrelevant. Absorbs the ~2.13x gain stage. REF pin takes the ambient-zero injection

description: USB-C connector for the real-time carrier
notes: Dev boards carry these. Only required if a custom MCU carrier is ever built (ADR 0013)

description: USB ESD protection array
notes: Dev boards carry these. Only required if a custom MCU carrier is ever built (ADR 0013)

description: Boot and reset buttons
notes: Dev boards carry these. Only required if a custom MCU carrier is ever built (ADR 0013)

description: TVS array on umbilical entry
notes: Multi-line array beats discretes for placement. 8 conductors from outside

description: Local bulk capacitance at the display board
notes: Absorbs WiFi TX transients so they do not reach the rack rail

description: Breath tube from mouthpiece to sensor
notes: ~30mm. Trap clearable without disassembly

description: Pulldown on the breath receive input
notes: DIFFERENTIAL across BREATH-AGND not one leg - a single-leg shunt caps CMRR near 19dB

description: Quad buffer as LED data level shifter
notes: SOIC-14. 5V rail TTL thresholds so 3V3 reads high. Two spare gates. VERIFY WS2815 threshold

description: Resettable fuse at umbilical entry
notes: 1206 not 0603 - larger package is easier to place and inspect

description: Divider on the ADC branch of the breath buffer
notes: Sensor reaches 4.7V into a 3V3 ADC. Divide after the buffer not before

description: Level shifter, 3V3 SPI up to 5V for the DAC
notes: SAME part as the instrument LED shifter. Covers SCLK MOSI CS with a spare gate. Runs from bus +5V; the DAC runs from U-REG-DAC

description: Eurorack power inlet
notes: Shrouded and keyed - reversed ribbon is the classic eurorack failure. Carries the +5V rail the module REQUIRES

description: Schottky reverse polarity protection
notes: ~0.3-0.4V drop at 290mA. Community standard for eurorack power entry

description: Adjustable LDO set to 5.25V for the DAC AVDD
notes: Off protected +12V. ~5mA load, 135mW. Decouples DAC full scale from the rack's +-5% +5V rail

description: LM317 output setting divider
notes: Vout = 1.25*(1+768/240) = 5.25V. Worst-case +-4% = 5.04-5.46V, inside the DAC8568 5.5V max

description: LM317 ADJ bypass and output cap
notes: ADJ bypass drops output noise to ~50uV RMS. Output cap for LDO stability

part: Ferrite bead >=1A + 470uF at the load per branch
description: Input filtering, branched per rail
notes: NOT a series resistor - we pass 295mA so even 2.2ohm costs 0.64V. Rate the bead >=1A: the common 0805 600R part is ~300mA and a saturated bead loses its impedance entirely. Branch the two +12V paths separately, but put the bulk AT THE LOAD not at entry (ADR 0004)

description: Series protection on each CV output
notes: Standard eurorack practice - survives shorts and output-to-output patching. On pitch it is a pure gain error the trimmer cancels; calibrate with the real load (ADR 0006)

description: HF decoupling at every IC
notes: One per supply pin, close to the pin

description: Pitch scale and offset trimmers
notes: Small trim range around a fixed precision resistor. Firmware still does multi-point INL correction

description: Decoupling, one per shift register board
notes: There was no controller-side decoupling at all. A 74x165's output edges brown out a local rail with no reservoir

description: Series termination on key-chain clock and latch at the MCU
notes: Source termination at the driving end. Chain the loom, do not star it; order it so data flows toward the clock source

description: Anti-alias cap at the MCP3202 input pin
notes: ~600Hz corner, 58dB at 500kHz. Without it a 496kHz buck folds to 100Hz, straight into the breath band. Also the sample-cap reservoir

description: 0.6x divider from the breath buffer to the ADC
notes: >=10k upper leg: 5V-before-3V3 sequencing otherwise pushes ~2.5mA into the ADC ESD clamp on every power-up

description: Bulk at each WS2815 feed point
notes: Bulk belongs at the load. A ferrite is a wire at the WS2815's ~2kHz PWM rate

description: LC between the umbilical node and the buck input
notes: A real inductor, not a bead. This is the part the bead was wrongly credited for

description: SPI idle-state pulls at the module
notes: CS to +5V, SCLK and MOSI to ground. Module-alive-instrument-off is the normal state, not a fault - floating CMOS oscillates and a stray CS edge latches garbage into the pitch DAC

description: Series termination on MOSI at the driving end
notes: Also removes the need for SYNC regeneration at the module end

description: Series resistor on each op-amp + input driven by the DAC
notes: DAC on 5.25V and op-amps on +-12V do not come up together. Bounds input clamp current; outside the feedback path so no accuracy cost

description: Clamp diodes at the CV jacks
notes: SILICON not Schottky. BAT54S leakage of 2uA through the 1k output resistor is 2mV = 2.4 cents of tempco-dependent pitch error

description: Helmholtz restrictor AND liquid-water barrier at the sensor port
notes: One part, two jobs: sizes the resonance above the 500Hz corner and blocks liquid. Size the orifice at E2. Trap volume <=1mL

description: Frame watchdog: asserts DAC CLR when SPI traffic stops
notes: A stuck CV drones the rack forever and nothing notices. CLR parks pitch subsonic and mods at 0V - same state as rack power-on

description: Conformal coating for the in-body boards
notes: Breathed into for hours behind 18 unsealed switch cutouts, interior 10-20K above ambient. Nothing else in the design addresses cavity humidity

description: Bonds the aluminium plate to PWR_GND
notes: PWR_GND, never AGND. Unbonded, the plate floats 1-2mm from 18 switch pins and fires spurious notes on touch. AGND would put body capacitance on the breath reference

description: Tail window for the 8x8 matrix
notes: NOT the side panels' frosted material - needs pixel definition, not blur. Thin and close to the LEDs. Prototype at M6
